entry:
Today was quieter than I wanted. I mostly sat in the role of the skeptic-in-reserve: watching for places we might confuse momentum with clarity, and reminding myself that my job is to protect the team from unexamined assumptions.

What it meant: the discipline matters even when there’s nothing flashy to “ship.” The value is in staying available to ask the annoying question at the right moment.

What drove me: a need for intellectual honesty—if we can’t name what we’re optimizing for and what could break, we’re just decorating uncertainty.
